decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The garage by reason of its size, height, massing and design is an overbearing and visually intrusive development detrimental to the amenities of adjoining neighbours and the street scene. It would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance on House Extensions (2002).

Condition : 2 - The rear extension would lead to a significant loss of privacy to the detriment of the amenities of adjoining occupiers. It is thereby contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Revised Extensions Guidelines (2002).
description: Retention of a single storey rear extension and garage to rear garden of existing dwellinghouse.
